about: Which generic events (events.json) each platform can trigger, what triggers them, and whether each is on by default. An event a platform cannot trigger is still kept in schemes for previews and other platforms.

startup.trigger: agent starts at login within 15 minutes of boot

login.trigger: agent starts at login, later than 15 minutes after boot

shutdown.trigger: log out, restart or shut down (NSWorkspace will-power-off, then SIGTERM), best effort

sleep.trigger: system will sleep (IOKit power, sleep held briefly so the sound finishes)

wake.trigger: system has powered on after sleep

device_connect.trigger: USB device attached (IOUSBHostDevice) or Bluetooth keyboard, mouse or other HID device connected (IOKit registry)

device_disconnect.trigger: USB device removed or Bluetooth HID device disconnected

power_connected.trigger: power source changes to AC (IOPS); laptops and UPS only

power_disconnected.trigger: power source changes to battery or UPS (IOPS)

battery_low.trigger: battery or UPS at or below 10 percent

battery_critical.trigger: battery or UPS at or below 5 percent

empty_trash.trigger: ~/.Trash goes from having items to empty

new_mail.trigger: Mail's inbox unread count rises (polled only while Mail is running; asks for Automation permission once)

default_beep.trigger: system alert sound, when 'winsounds alert on' installs it

battery_critical.trigger: battery level at or below 5 percent (ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED)

new_mail.trigger: notification posted by the default mail app

message.trigger: notification posted by a messaging app
